python3 << 'EOF'
# Values for Export-Import Bank Direct Sales (1963-1974)
values = [366, 436, 124, 63, 153, 91, 379, 406, 269, 248, 145, 21]
years = [1963, 1964, 1965, 1966, 1967, 1968, 1969, 1970, 1971, 1972, 1973, 1974]

# Sort values to find median
sorted_values = sorted(values)
print("Sorted values:", sorted_values)
print("Years correspond:", sorted(zip(sorted_values, [1963, 1964, 1965, 1966, 1967, 1968, 1969, 1970, 1971, 1972, 1973, 1974]))

# Calculate median (12 values, so average of 6th and 7th)
median = (sorted_values[5] + sorted_values[6]) / 2
print(f"\nMedian = ({sorted_values[5]} + {sorted_values[6]}) / 2 = {median}")

# Value for 1974
value_1974 = 21
print(f"\nValue for 1974: {value_1974}")

# Signed deviation
deviation = value_1974 - median
print(f"Signed deviation = {value_1974} - {median} = {deviation}")

# Rounded to one decimal place
print(f"Rounded to 1 decimal place: {round(deviation, 1)}")
EOF
